Factors effect hotel booking demand [common] 1. month–Which month has the highest reservation?–histogram (JIANG) 2. room price–How ADR related to the reservation frequency?–histogram (LEI)

[different] 1. customer type–How the four customer type(baby, children, both, only adult) distribute in two hotels–pie chart (YAO) 2. customer requests– 2 charts. [Bar Chart 1] chart is about the total numbers of car parkings the two hotel request. [Line Chart 2] The number of car parking hotel request divided based on the time. (WEI)

[conclusion] (ZHU)

#1.JIANG- Month
hotel_data <- read_csv("data/hotel_booking.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

hotel_data %>%
  summarise(
    missing_month = sum(is.na(arrival_date_month)),
    missing_year = sum(is.na(arrival_date_year))
  )
## # A tibble: 1 × 2
##   missing_month missing_year
##           <int>        <int>
## 1             0            0
sum(duplicated(hotel_data))
## [1] 0
month_order <- c(
  "January", "February", "March", "April",
  "May", "June", "July", "August",
  "September", "October", "November", "December"
)

hotel_data <- hotel_data %>%
  mutate(
    arrival_date_month = factor(
      arrival_date_month,
      levels = month_order,
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(arrival_date_month),
    !is.na(arrival_date_year)
  )

hotel_data %>%
  filter(is_canceled == 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = arrival_date_month)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "tomato") +
  labs(
    title = "Cancelled Reservations by Arrival Month",
    x = "Arrival month",
    y = "Number of cancelled reservations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

hotel_data %>%
  filter(is_canceled == 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = arrival_date_month)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Non-cancelled Reservations by Arrival Month",
    x = "Arrival month",
    y = "Number of reservations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

monthly_reservations <- hotel_data %>%
  filter(is_canceled == 0) %>%
  count(arrival_date_month, name = "reservations") %>%
  arrange(desc(reservations))

monthly_reservations

#2.LEI-Room Price
hotel_clean <- hotel_data %>%
    filter(adr > 0)
ggplot(hotel_clean, aes(x = adr)) +
geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 30,
    boundary = 0
) +
xlim(0,400) +
facet_wrap(~hotel) +
labs(
    title = "Figure2:Distribution of ADR in City Hotels and Resort Hotels", 
    x = "ADR", 
    y = "reservation frequency"
)

#3.YAO - Guest Composition Analysis
hotel_data <- read_csv("data/hotel_booking.csv",
                       show_col_types = FALSE)

guest_data <- hotel_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(adults),
         !is.na(children),
         !is.na(babies),
         adults + children + babies > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    guest_group = case_when(
      children > 0 & babies > 0 ~ "With both",
      children > 0 ~ "With children only",
      babies > 0 ~ "With babies only",
      TRUE ~ "Adults only"
    )
  )

guest_summary <- guest_data %>%
  count(hotel, guest_group) %>%
  group_by(hotel) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

print(guest_summary)
## # A tibble: 8 × 4
##   hotel        guest_group            n percentage
##   <chr>        <chr>              <int>      <dbl>
## 1 City Hotel   Adults only        73756   0.932   
## 2 City Hotel   With babies only     297   0.00375 
## 3 City Hotel   With both             72   0.000910
## 4 City Hotel   With children only  5034   0.0636  
## 5 Resort Hotel Adults only        36118   0.902   
## 6 Resort Hotel With babies only     445   0.0111  
## 7 Resort Hotel With both            103   0.00257 
## 8 Resort Hotel With children only  3381   0.0844
ggplot(guest_summary,
       aes(x = "", y = percentage, fill = guest_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_wrap(~ hotel) +

geom_text(
  aes(label = ifelse(
    percentage >= 0.05,
    scales::percent(percentage, accuracy = 0.1),
    ""
  )),
  position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
  size = 3
) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure3:Guest Composition by Hotel Type",
    fill = "Guest Group"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

#4.WEI-customer requests
hotel_bookings <- read_csv("data/hotel_booking.csv") 
## Rows: 119390 Columns: 36
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr  (15): hotel, arrival_date_month, meal, country, market_segment, distrib...
## dbl  (20): is_canceled, lead_time, arrival_date_year, arrival_date_week_numb...
## date  (1): reservation_status_date
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
parking_by_hotel <- hotel_bookings %>%
group_by(hotel) %>%
summarise(
total_parking = sum(required_car_parking_spaces, na.rm = TRUE)
)
ggplot(parking_by_hotel, aes(x = hotel, 
               y = total_parking)) +
geom_col() +
labs(
        title = "Figure4:Total Car Parking Spaces Required by Hotel Type",
        x = "Hotel Type",
        y = "Total Parking Spaces"
)

parking_by_month <- hotel_bookings %>%
mutate(
              arrival_date_month = factor(
              arrival_date_month,
              levels = month.name
            )
) %>%
group_by(arrival_date_year, arrival_date_month) %>%
summarise(
                    total_parking = sum(required_car_parking_spaces, na.rm = TRUE)
)
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by arrival_date_year and arrival_date_month.
## ℹ Output is grouped by arrival_date_year.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(arrival_date_year, arrival_date_month))` for
##   per-operation grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
ggplot(parking_by_month, aes(x = arrival_date_month,
                     y = total_parking,
                     group = arrival_date_year,
                     colour = factor(arrival_date_year))) +
geom_line() +
geom_point() +
labs(
        title = "Figure5:Monthly Car Parking Demand from 2015 to 2017",
        x = "Month",
        y = "Total Parking Spaces",
        colour = "Year"
)
